subject: Operations
title: Egyptian Pyramid Logistics
description: A micro-lesson that makes Egyptian Pyramid Logistics usable.

hook.text: The Great Pyramid used 2.3 million stone blocks. Each weighed more than a car. No cranes existed.

buildup.text: Thousands of workers were organized into teams with specific roles: cutting, moving, lifting, feeding.

discovery.text: Ramps, levers, and sleds replaced brute force. Clever process design multiplied human power.

twist.text: Recent evidence suggests workers were paid, fed well, and rotated—not enslaved as myths claimed.

climax.text: The pyramids prove that operations management existed 4,500 years before anyone named it.

punchline.text: History's first megaproject ran on logistics.

quiz.question: How many stone blocks were used in the Great Pyramid?
